evidence.reason: The object literal at `queueCell.ts:212-218` uses `...effects`, which copies only own enumerable properties. Because `ReviewLaunchEffects` is a method interface, a class instance is structurally assignable while its prototype methods (e.g. `writeMeta`) are omitted; `reserveAndSpawnReview` then calling `effects.writeMeta(...)` can throw `TypeError`. Explicit delegation preserves the original receiver and fixes the defect without changing intended behavior.
